speckit.name: Full SDD Cycle
speckit.description: Runs specify → plan → tasks → implement with review gates

implement-phased.name: Phased implementation with validation loop
implement-phased.description: Executes tasks.md one '## Phase' group at a time. Each group is implemented by a fresh agent, then checked by the repository gates and an independent judge agent; failing rounds get a fix agent, up to max_rounds, before the next group starts. Ends with a whole-diff review, the full gate, and a committed report.
